9c4839a8: What is the name of My Hero Academia's protagonist?
Izuku Midoriya (Deku) was born Quirkless in a world where 80% of people have one — he receives One For All from All Might and becomes the successor of the world's greatest hero.
41615a17: One For All is a Quirk that stockpiles power and is passed on — Midoriya is its ninth holder, inheriting the strength and also the Quirks of the previous holders.
1aea9aa4: Bakugo creates explosions from his palms by sweating a nitroglycerin-like substance — propulsive and offensive, they also let him fly.
10a45154: Who is the number 1 hero at the start of the series?
All Might (Toshinori Yagi) is Japan's number 1 hero and the “Symbol of Peace”. He has to retire after using up his strength against All For One.
7282c3c0: Which Quirk is the direct opposite of One For All?
All For One is the opposite Quirk — it steals other people's Quirks and can give them to others. Held by the villain of the same name, it is the reason One For All exists: to fight it.
2d3e1628: U.A. is Japan's most prestigious hero school. Deku enters its Hero Course, in Class 1-A.
9a98c8d9: Half-Cold Half-Hot lets Shoto create ice from his right side (from his mother) and fire from his left side (from Endeavor) — for a long time he refused to use the fire out of rejection of his father.
418734f4: Which villain leads the League of Villains at the start?

Tomura Shigaraki is the leader of the League of Villains — his Quirk, Decay, disintegrates anything he touches with all five fingers. All For One's protégé, he is actually the grandson of one of All Might's teachers.
4005667a: Decay disintegrates anything he touches with five fingers — it later evolves to spread in waves without direct contact. Shigaraki wears gloves to avoid accidents.
6d773c47: The Big Three are U.A.'s three best students — Mirio Togata (Permeation), Tamaki Amajiki (Manifest) and Nejire Hado (Wave Motion). They are third-years.
6919e9a7: Endeavor (Enji Todoroki) is Shoto's father — a hero with the Hellflame Quirk. His abusive treatment of his family is central to Shoto's development.
3003ef79: Which villain leads the Shie Hassaikai yakuza group?
Kai Chisaki (Overhaul) can disassemble and reassemble anything he touches — he creates Quirk-destroying bullets by experimenting on little Eri, who has the power to rewind.
818242e5: What is the Quirk of Hawks, the number 2 hero?
Fierce Wings lets Hawks control his feathers with precision — as blades, a shield or a means of transport. He loses his large feathers when Dabi burns them.
a66397d5: What is the real link between Dabi and Endeavor?
Dabi is Toya Todoroki, Endeavor's eldest son, believed dead — his Blueflame Quirk is hotter than Endeavor's red fire but burns his own body, causing his scars.
7cc22868: What is a Nomu in the series?
An artificial human with several grafted Quirks
Nomu are human bodies modified by All For One — several confiscated Quirks are grafted onto them to make perfect anti-hero weapons.
e759d565: What is Shota Aizawa's (Eraser Head) Quirk?
Erasure cancels the Quirk of whoever Aizawa is looking at. The effect stops as soon as he blinks.
0bd32b5f: Zero Gravity cancels the gravity of anything she touches with all five fingers — she releases the effect by pressing her fingertips together. She can make debris, people or herself float.
9ff4d44e: What is U.A. High School's motto?
“Plus Ultra!” is U.A.'s motto — inspired by the Latin “Non plus ultra” and turned around to mean “always go further”. It is the students' rallying cry.
5c8d826e: Creation lets Momo create any non-living object from her skin by converting her body fat — it requires encyclopedic knowledge of what objects are made of.
9729b667: What is the name of Shigaraki's group after merging with the Meta Liberation Army?
The Paranormal Liberation Front is the merger of the League of Villains and the Meta Liberation Army — creating the largest criminal organization in Japan.
5837f9d5: Transform lets Toga take on someone's appearance by drinking their blood — in the later arcs, with enough blood, she can even copy their Quirk.
7ab51801: What is All Might's real name?
Toshinori Yagi is All Might's real name — in his weakened form, he is very thin and sickly. He passes One For All on to Deku after seeing him run, powerless, to save Bakugo.
0e7a169c: Which attack does All Might use to defeat All For One at Kamino?
United States of Smash is All Might's last blow, struck at Kamino to defeat All For One. The fight uses up his strength for good.
f5268842: Which exam do Bakugo and Todoroki fail in season 3?
Bakugo and Todoroki fail the Provisional Hero License Exam because of their behavior. They have to take remedial classes to get it.
9d8f3285: What is Tenya Iida's Quirk called?
Engine is Iida's Quirk — he has engines in his calves that let him reach extraordinary speeds. He can also use special moves like Recipro Burst.
16c84c23: Frog is Tsuyu Asui's Quirk — all the abilities of a frog: jumping very high, camouflage, an extendable tongue that can carry heavy loads, breathing underwater and climbing walls.
292f0e61: Which hero teaches Deku to spread One For All throughout his whole body?
Gran Torino, All Might's former teacher, teaches Deku to spread a small portion of One For All throughout his body so he stops breaking his limbs.
3e7eb9d9: Which masked League of Villains member uses a Quirk that condenses objects and people into tiny marbles?
Mr. Compress (Atsuhiro Sako) can compress anything or anyone into small marbles — and decompress them at will. He kidnapped Bakugo with this technique during the training camp.
5c17cded: What is Eijiro Kirishima's (Red Riot) Quirk?
Hardening lets Kirishima harden his skin until it is as tough as rock — he can withstand almost any direct attack. His Unbreakable form is the ultimate version of this technique.
8ae85406: How many students make up U.A.'s Class 1-A?
Class 1-A has 20 students, each with a different Quirk.
370f6913: What links All For One and the first holder of One For All?
The first holder, Yoichi, is All For One's younger brother. All For One forced a power-stockpiling Quirk on him, which merged with Yoichi's hidden Quirk for passing power on, creating One For All.
2fa82214: What is Shigaraki's real family link with one of All Might's teachers?
Tomura Shigaraki is actually the grandson of Nana Shimura — a former holder of One For All and All Might's teacher. All For One deliberately recruited and corrupted Shigaraki to hurt All Might.
25e4c2be: Which group attacks Class 1-A's summer camp to kidnap Bakugo?
The Vanguard Action Squad is an elite League of Villains group sent to kidnap Bakugo at the training camp — with Dabi, Toga, Compress, Muscular and others.
8a0f89a3: What is the name of Re-Destro's terrorist group in My Hero Academia?
Re-Destro's Meta Liberation Army advocates total freedom to use Quirks. Defeated by the League of Villains, it merges with it to form the Paranormal Liberation Front.
e2fcba17: Who is the first major villain of season 1 to attack the students?
Tomura Shigaraki leads the attack on the USJ in season 1 with Kurogiri and the Nomu. His goal is to kill All Might.
baf394e9: What is the signature move that made Bakugo famous at the Sports Festival?
Howitzer Impact is Bakugo's finishing move — he spins himself while building up explosions until he unleashes a huge concentrated blast. He uses it against Todoroki in the Sports Festival final.
b29330d2: What is the name of Denki Kaminari's Quirk, which makes him dim-witted if he overuses it?
Electrification lets Kaminari generate and release electricity — if he exceeds his limit, he short-circuits his brain and goes dim-witted for a while. His wattage limit is therefore crucial.
df0fb921: Which rival U.A. class often challenges 1-A?
Class 1-B is 1-A's direct rival in U.A.'s Hero Course — with students like Monoma (Copy), who constantly mocks 1-A, and a wide range of Quirks.
9f9e81d2: Which Quirk lets Hitoshi Shinso mentally control people?
Shinso's Brainwash controls anyone who answers him — he just has to get a verbal response. His Quirk is seen as villain-like, but he wants to become a hero.
7f0ff0f9: What is Todoroki's technique combining ice and fire called?
Flashfreeze Heatwave combines fire and ice — Shoto first freezes the area and then heats it violently, creating a devastating temperature difference. He uses it in advanced fights.
388aca95: What event sets off Shigaraki's transformation into a supervillain?
The accident where his Decay kills his family
As a child, Tenko Shimura's Quirk awakens and he disintegrates his family. All For One then takes him in and feeds his hatred of heroes.
e2285d4b: Which government body oversees pro heroes and trained Hawks since childhood?
The Hero Public Safety Commission oversees pro heroes. We learn that it raised and trained Hawks from childhood to make him an agent.
678c9dbf: Which Quirk lets Mirko (Rumi Usagiyama) jump and kick like a rabbit?
Rabbit gives Mirko the abilities of a rabbit, including devastating jumps and kicks. She is the number 5 hero and prefers to fight alone.
a374a078: In which arc do Deku and Mirio fight Overhaul to save Eri?
In the Shie Hassaikai arc (season 4), Overhaul (Kai Chisaki) keeps Eri prisoner to make Quirk-destroying bullets — Deku and Mirio fight to free her in a very emotional arc.
6b8f7b71: What is the season 1 story arc built around an attack on a training facility?
The assault on the USJ (Unforeseen Simulation Joint) is the first big arc — the League of Villains attacks the training facility with the Nomu. All Might arrives spectacularly to save the students.
05360535: What is the Quirk of Fumikage Tokoyami, Class 1-A's dark student?
Dark Shadow is a shadow creature living in Tokoyami's body — it can fight on its own. Stronger in total darkness but harder to control, it is tamed and weakened by light.
388742c5: What is Dabi's real name, whose reveal shocks the world?
Toya Todoroki is Dabi's real name — Endeavor's eldest son, believed dead. His Blueflame Quirk is hotter than Endeavor's but burns his own body, causing his distinctive purple scars.
be047acc: What is the Quirk of Class 1-A's Mina Ashido (Pinky)?
Acid is Mina Ashido's Quirk — she can secrete acid from her skin to attack or dissolve objects. She controls its viscosity and strength, from a slippery acid to a destructive one.
c9ce55d2: Which League member can duplicate anyone but suffers from an identity crisis?
Twice (Jin Bubaigawara) can create doubles of anyone. Haunted by a past in which his own clones fought each other to the death, he constantly doubts that he is the original. He is killed by Hawks.
54f7b439: Which Quirk lets Kyoka Jiro plug her long earlobes into surfaces to amplify sounds?
Earphone Jack — Jiro has extendable jacks instead of earlobes. She can plug them into surfaces to listen through walls or send devastating sound vibrations as an attack.
f37c46de: What are evolved Nomu, able to think and speak like Hood, called?

High-End Nomu are an evolution of standard Nomu — they have several grafted Quirks but also residual intelligence that lets them think and adapt in combat. Hood is the first High-End that Endeavor faces.
ba135ff4: What event causes All Might's final retirement and reveals his secret to the world?
His live-broadcast fight against All For One

The live-broadcast fight against All For One reveals All Might's true, emaciated form to everyone — he spends his last reserve of power to defeat All For One, declaring “Now it's your turn” to the world.
8f377cd3: What is the season 6 arc involving a massive war between heroes and villains?
The Paranormal Liberation War opens season 6: the heroes simultaneously attack the Front's base and Jaku Hospital, where Shigaraki is being modified.
